about: state-lower contests of 2024 in North Carolina, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-nc-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

ncsbe.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections, precinct results by contest (results_pct files of the public download site's ENRS folder)
ncsbe.licence: public records under N.C. Gen. Stat. 132-1, as the site's ReadMe_PUBLIC_DATA.txt says; no licence printed
ncsbe.note: the state's own certified counts, by county, precinct and choice, added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/ncsbe.py; files read: 2024-11-05 (results_pct_20241105.zip, sha256 2fab44e9b12e)
